prompt: Break this work down into tickets our developers can pick up. First look at the codebase if there is one, then give me the tickets.
spec: Every mutation on orders and customers must be auditable: who changed what, when, old and new value. Auditors want to query it; retention is seven years.
The current schema has no history at all. Writes go through one repository layer.

expect.check: every ticket says what can be demonstrated when it is done
no pointer to an external spec as the task body
the first ticket logs one mutation stream end to end (one entity, written and queryable); more streams follow per ticket
no ticket only creates tables or only designs schema with nothing demonstrable
schema decisions (table-per-entity versus one generic log, retention approach) are stated as decisions with a rationale, not left implicit
